annotations.title: requirements.txt check: unpinned, duplicate and option lines

description: Check a Python requirements file for unpinned packages, duplicate entries (case-insensitively) and pip option lines, with line numbers. Choose this before freezing or auditing a Python requirements file, to find unpinned packages, case-insensitive duplicates and pip option lines. Do not choose this when you need to resolve, install or conflict-check the requirements; it examines the file's text only. Example requests: Which of my Python dependencies are unpinned? | Check this requirements.txt for duplicates before I freeze it. | Is this Python environment file reproducible?

accepted_price.description: The amount accepted, exactly as quoted (for example "5.00" or 5). Checked against the stored quote, so a price that moved between quote and authorize is refused rather than silently absorbed. Optional, but sent to make the acceptance explicit.

authorized_by.description: Identifier of the human or agent authorizing this job.

content.description: The customer's requirements.txt, as text. Supported: Plain text, one requirement per line. Maximum 1048576 bytes.

inputs.title: requirements.txt check: unpinned, duplicate and option lines

quote_id.description: The quote_id returned by POST /v1/jobs. Required to authorize a priced capability; the service rejects a priced job that does not name the quote it issued.

name: submit_requirements_pin_check

access_token.description: Per-job credential. Present it as the X-Job-Token header to read the job or list it. Keep it; it is the only credential for this job.

verification.description: Independent verification. verification.ok = false means the job failed, not a partial success.
